task.description: Validate CODE-DESIGNER's design at lib/letflow/design/req051-parallel-gateway-split-join.md against REQ-051's 6 acceptance criteria (see handoffs/WF02-REQ051-20260818/step-01-code-designer.json's task.description/acceptance_criteria for the full requirement text). Key mechanisms to verify independently: (1) branch_id scheme (parent_token_id <> "/" <> declaration_order_index) actually produces N distinct branch_ids deterministically and purely; (2) new JoinCounter struct + InstanceState.join_counters field is genuinely pure data, no process/GenServer; (3) the new cancelled-branch representation ({:cancel_branch, branch_id} event + cancelled_branches MapSet) is entirely this requirement's own -- confirm it does NOT silently assume REQ-052 exists; (4) join_outcome/1's :wait|:fire|:cancel_join set-algebra (expected - (received ∪ cancelled)) correctly implements all-cancelled -> :cancel_join -> instance CANCELLED, and fire-exactly-once under any arrival order; (5) REQ-049's VariableMerge.merge/3 is genuinely reused, not reimplemented.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of REQ-051's 6 acceptance criteria maps to a concrete design element -- verify by direct cross-reference, not by trusting the design doc's own traceability claims.
The cancelled-branch representation is genuinely self-contained (no unstated dependency on REQ-052).

join_outcome/1's logic is checked against edge cases: 0 branches cancelled+all received (fire), all cancelled (cancel_join), a mix (fire once remaining active arrive), concurrent/reordered arrival (still exactly-once).
REQ-049's merge function is called, not duplicated.
No implementation code in the design artifact.
The 8 listed open questions are genuinely non-blocking for ELIXIR-DEV, or if any IS blocking, this is a FAIL requiring CODE-DESIGNER to resolve it.

The MINOR issue CODE-DESIGNER flagged (req049-variable-scoping-merge.md vs actual req049-variable-merge.md filename in its own artifacts_in) doesn't indicate the design was built against the wrong/nonexistent file.
